description: Số lượng tài khoản giao dịch chứng chỉ quỹ đã mở trong kỳ
etl_logic: (SELECT TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(CAST(fmr_value.cell_val AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '%', '') DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) FROM fmr_value INNER JOIN fmr_submission ON fmr_submission.fmr_submission_id = fmr_value.fmr_submission_id AND fmr_submission.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_MEMBER' INNER JOIN fund_management_rpt_cell_dim ON fund_management_rpt_cell_dim.fmr_sheet_code = fmr_value.fmr_sheet_code AND fund_management_rpt_cell_dim.cell_id = fmr_value.cell_id WHERE fmr_submission.securities_distribution_agent_id = securities_distribution_agent.securities_distribution_agent_id AND fmr_submission.record_tp = '8' AND fmr_submission.record_status_code IN ('2','3','5','10') AND fmr_value.src_stm_code = 'FMS_RPT_VALUES' AND fmr_submission.submitted_dt <= :etl_date AND fund_management_rpt_cell_dim.fmr_sheet_nm = 'TinhHinhGiaoDichCCQ_06268' AND LOWER(fund_management_rpt_cell_dim.fmr_nm) LIKE '%đại lý phân phối%' AND fund_management_rpt_cell_dim.row_stt_code = '1' AND fund_management_rpt_cell_dim.column_label_nm = 'Kỳ báo cáo' ORDER BY fmr_submission.rpt_year DESC, CASE fmr_submission.period_tp_code WHEN '3' THEN CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(fmr_submission.period_val, '^T(\d{2})/', 1), ''), fmr_submission.period_val) AS INT) WHEN '4' THEN 3 * CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(fmr_submission.period_val, '^Q(\d)/', 1), ''), fmr_submission.period_val) AS INT) WHEN '5' THEN 6 WHEN '6' THEN 12 END DESC, fmr_submission.period_tp_code DESC, fmr_submission.submitted_dt DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY)
source_entity: Fund Management Report Value / Fund Management Report Submission
source_attribute: Fund Management Report Value.Cell Value / Fund Management Report Submission.Securities Distribution Agent Id
